title: Adapting models to concept drift
text: stream two numeric features drawn distribution whole stream. rule defines target changes: observation 750 target x1 + x2 > 0, x1 - x2 > 0. real concept drift, inputs look relationship target changed.
code: set.seed(1) n <- 1500 x <- data.frame(x1 = rnorm(n), x2 = rnorm(n)) new_concept <- seq_len(n) > 750 target <- ifelse(new_concept, x$x1 - x$x2 > 0, x$x1 + x$x2 > 0) y <- data.frame(target = factor(target, levels = c(FALSE, TRUE)))  batch <- (seq_len(n) - 1) %/% 50 + 1

what: Training and testing batch by batch
title: Adapting models to concept drift
text: stream processed batches 50 observations. batch first used test current model given fit(), updates model . classifier naive Bayes model daltoolbox. dfr_inactive() never reports drift, model keeps accumulating data concepts. dfr_ddm() monitors mistakes classifier. drift detected, model needs warmup_size observations trained , accuracy missing one batch.
code: run_stream <- function(detector) {   model <- stealthy(cla_nb("target", c("FALSE", "TRUE")), detector, warmup_size = 100)   results <- NULL   for (b in 2:max(batch)) {     train <- batch == (b - 1)     test <- batch == b     model <- fit(model, x[train, ], y[train, , drop = FALSE])      accuracy <- NA     if (model$fitted) {       prediction <- predict(model, x[test, ])       accuracy <- mean((prediction[, 2] > 0.5) == (y$target[test] == "TRUE"))     }     results <- rbind(results, data.frame(batch = b, drifted = model$drifted, accuracy = accuracy))   }   results } without_detector <- run_stream(dfr_inactive()) with_ddm <- run_stream(dfr_ddm())  with_ddm[with_ddm$drifted, ] #>    batch drifted accuracy #> 16    17    TRUE       NA plot(without_detector$batch, without_detector$accuracy, type = "b", pch = 16,      ylim = c(0.4, 1), col = "grey50", xlab = "batch", ylab = "accuracy") lines(with_ddm$batch, with_ddm$accuracy, type = "b", pch = 16, col = "steelblue") abline(v = 750 / 50 + 0.5, lty = 2, col = "grey70") legend("bottomleft", c("dfr_inactive()", "dfr_ddm()"), col = c("grey50", "steelblue"),        pch = 16, bty = "n", cex = 0.8) after <- with_ddm$batch > 16 c(   without_detector = mean(without_detector$accuracy[after], na.rm = TRUE),   with_ddm = mean(with_ddm$accuracy[after], na.rm = TRUE) ) #> without_detector         with_ddm  #>        0.6728571        0.9630769

title: Getting started with heimdall
text: Every detector follows three rules: update_state(obj, value) processes one observation returns list updated detector (obj) flag (drift) telling whether drift detected call; obj$drifted sticky: stays TRUE first detection; reset_state(obj) returns detector initial state, usually right drift handled. loop canonical way running detector stream. works unchanged detector package.
code: detect <- function(model, stream) {   output <- list(obj = model, drift = FALSE)   drifts <- integer(0)   for (i in seq_along(stream)) {     output <- update_state(output$obj, stream[i])     if (output$drift) {       drifts <- c(drifts, i)       output$obj <- reset_state(output$obj)     }   }   drifts }

title: heimdall (development version)
text: fit() univariate detector now monitors target_feat given data frame. used concatenate every column single stream. data frame several columns target_feat now error instead silently concatenated. update_state() rejects ambiguous input instead guessing: vectors one value, text number, , error-based detectors, values 0, 1, TRUE FALSE. Factors read labels (previously internal codes), infinite values treated missing, warning. dfr_cusum() reimplemented MOA’s CusumDM, arguments lambda (now 50), delta min_instances. previous version added +1 per error -1 per correct prediction, detect error rates 50%. dfr_multi_criteria() longer keeps obj$drifts, grew every observation. Use obj$detections (alarms per detector) obj$last_drifts (decisions last observation) instead. "" now accepts detections fuzzy_window observations apart (used require observation, almost never happens), "" "fuzzy" report change instead several consecutive observations. "fuzzy" combination now costs per observation regardless length stream. New defaults, calibrated simulation keep false alarms rare: dfr_kldist(p_th = 0.5), dfr_kswin(window_size = 300, stat_size = 100, alpha = 1e-4, exact = NULL), dfr_lbdd(window_size = 300, alpha = 0.001), dfr_mcdd(window_size = 300, alpha = 1e-4), dfr_ecdd(average_run_length = 400) dfr_aedd(monitoring_step = window_size / 2). previous windows 1500 observations three times longer bundled example data. dfr_aedd() now uses daltoolboxdp::autoenc_ed default autoencoder; previous default longer exists daltoolbox.

title: heimdall (development version)

Precision, recall, F-score accuracy accept factor character labels. factor y_true, precision returned 1.5 recall NaN. metrics now also refuse vectors different lengths instead recycling . mt_rocauc() drops observations missing scores, warning, instead scoring zero. nrm_memory() longer drops repeated rows history, distorted normalization (z-score 1.79 came 0.71). stealthy(target_uni_drifter = TRUE) works factor targets; used feed NA detector, never detected anything. stealthy() now honours monitored_features, ignored. Warm-start data (data =) longer window_size truncated recent observations; used make window permanently longer. dfr_kswin() rejects window_size == stat_size, crashed first test. dfr_multi_criteria() fails clear message detector’s target_feat missing data, instead never detecting.

text: fit() longer breaks stream single observation. dfr_cusum, dfr_ddm, dfr_ecdd, dfr_eddm dfr_hddm used 2:length(data), reversed c(2, 1) processed non-existent element followed duplicate first one. mt_fscore() now uses f argument beta F-beta score. previously stored parameter always computed F1. inverse_transform.nrm_memory() now inverts data given instead internal history, ignored. fit.nrm_memory() longer emits spurious warning injects row zeros history first call. dfr_ecdd() longer fails object 'control_limit' found average run lengths 1000; argument validated front. dfr_hddm() dfr_aedd() longer latch per-call drift flag. drift element returned update_state() refers current call; obj$drifted remains sticky reset_state(). dfr_mcdd() longer stores incoming observation twice window full drift detected. dfr_lbdd() longer discards incoming observation drift detected. levene criterion dfr_aedd() longer fails multivariate input; previous implementation referenced hard-coded V1 column never created. dfr_multi_criteria() validates drifter_list combination instead failing later object 'has_drift' found silently reusing previous detector’s output. dfr_mcdd() falls back nonparametric test windows larger 5000 observations, shapiro.test() undefined. Missing values now handled consistently: error-based detectors treat NA correct prediction, distribution-based detectors skip observation. dfr_eddm() dfr_hddm() previously raised error NA.

title: heimdall 1.3.0

title: heimdall 1.3.0
